name: Bachus Flufens' Cottage
title: Bachus Flufens' Cottage
summary: Bachus Flufens' former homestead at 43.6N 85.4W, from which the Hea Tumeroks chased her. A 24 m bamboo cottage with a tapered grass roof stands on a bluff (z 20) above the reedy marsh and the sea. Around it are a cabbage patch, a metal cage (now holding Reedshark pups), a bench and stools, and a 27 m tree beside it.

landmarks.name: Cabbage patch and cage
landmarks.note: Cabbages, the rusted metal cage 0x0200063C, flowers.

shots.notes: High angle. The camera hangs 48 m south-west of the cottage over the bluff edge, looking down 32 deg at the bamboo cottage, the cabbage patch and the Reedshark cage, with the reedy marsh and the sea below the bluff. It eases 4 m closer, with the afternoon sun behind the lens. A small rank-3 look.
